topics.title: Stern Show Chaos – Intern Drama & News Mishaps
topics.summary: During the show, Howard Stern hosts Fabio while discussing frustrated female callers. A chaotic exchange ensues involving makeup-clad intern Eliana, confused discussions about Peter Jennings’ Canadian nationality and Walter Cronkite's signoff, alongside stuttering John attempting to answer questions for WSRK radio. Ultimately, former intern Dave leaves due to conflict between Gary and Fred.

topics.title: Fred’s Unconventional Radio Interactions
topics.summary: During the broadcast, radio host Howard Stern engages in a series of unusual interactions with colleagues Fred and Gary. These include Fred’s obsessive focus on hiring interns, demanding French toast preparation, threatening legal action, and an unsettling interview with Dave questioning his talent. Gary's volatile reactions are highlighted alongside an incident involving David Nixon.

topics.title: Intern Troubles & Naked Contest
topics.summary: Dave promotes comedy club appearances and seeks bookings while discussing a former intern, David Race, who recounts a tumultuous year involving alleged incidents with a pistol. The show then introduces an attendee willing to participate in a contest requiring nudity for tickets, leading to awkward discussions about body image and potential implants.

topics.title: Mr. T's Gold and Confusions
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Mr. T engages in a chaotic interview filled with tangents about his personal life – including bizarre Korean names he bestows on guests, elaborate gold jewelry, and claims of wealth accumulated through hard work. He discusses religious skepticism towards political figures like Clinton while sharing anecdotes from his upbringing.

topics.title: Stern and Jackson Clash Over Jesse
topics.summary: During a radio show, Howard Stern and callers intensely debate Reverend Jesse Jackson’s behavior, criticizing his ‘loud’ actions while defending him for advocating for black people. The conversation quickly devolves into personal attacks regarding Jackson's finances and lifestyle, with participants making unsupported claims.

topics.title: Mr. T Discusses Comic Book and Personal Life
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Mr. T discusses his upcoming comic book series, ‘Mr. T & The T Force,’ focusing on crime prevention but reveals a complicated personal history including academic assistance from an unnamed classmate and details about seven brothers and several financially independent adult children due to his support; he also engages in tangential conversations regarding cheating in high school and the complexities of raising successful children.
